types.title: Contact
types.description: A person or organization in an address book.

types.title: Contact note
types.description: A user-authored note attached to a contact.

types.title: Contact tag
types.description: A book-scoped label assigned to contacts.

queries.title: List address books
queries.description: Normal entry for book-scoped Contacts work. List readable address books with effective permissions; use returned contacts.book refs or IDs with contact.list, tag.list, or contact.create.

query.description: Optional address-book name or description search.

minimumPermission.description: Minimum effective permission required for each returned address book.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Read address book
queries.description: Read one contacts.book ref or address-book ID returned by book.list.

id.description: Address-book ID returned by List address books or a contacts.book ref.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: List contacts
queries.description: Browse and filter contacts inside one known address book. Get bookId from book.list; use returned contacts.contact refs with contact.read. Use contact.search instead when no book is known.

bookId.description: Address-book ID returned by List address books or a contacts.book resource ref.

query.description: Optional text matched against contact fields.

tagIds.description: Contact-tag IDs returned by List contact tags for this address book; matches contacts having at least one.

favoritesOnly.description: Only contacts favorited by the current user.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

type.description: Namespaced resource type declared by the owning app.

priority.description: App-local relevance hint from zero to nine.

metadata.description: Small structured metadata shown with the result.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Read contact
queries.description: Read one contacts.contact ref returned by contact.search, contact.list, contact.suggest, or contact.resolve after checking its owning address book.

id.description: Contact ID returned by contact search, suggest, resolve, list, or a contacts.contact ref.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Resolve contacts by email
queries.description: Specialized lookup for known exact email addresses or contact IDs. Returns canonical contacts.contact refs; use contact.search when the contact is not known and contact.suggest for recipient suggestions.

emails.description: Normalized email addresses to resolve to every readable matching contact.

contactIds.description: Optional public contact IDs that further restrict the matches.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of exact contact matches to return.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Search contacts
queries.description: Normal cross-book discovery entry when no address book is known. Find contacts by name, email, phone, or book facet and use returned contacts.contact refs with contact.read.

query.description: User-entered search text. Empty text is allowed when a facet narrows the query.

tags.description: Canonical search facets supported by this query.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

type.description: Namespaced resource type declared by the owning app.

priority.description: App-local relevance hint from zero to nine.

metadata.description: Small structured metadata shown with the result.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

tags.title: Phone
tags.description: Show contacts that have a phone number.

tags.title: Email
tags.description: Show contacts that have an email address.

queries.title: Suggest contacts
queries.description: Specialized recipient picker for composing mail. Returns email-capable contacts and contacts.contact refs; use contact.search for general discovery or contact.resolve when exact email addresses are already known.

query.description: Text matched against readable contact names, organizations, email addresses, phone numbers, and addresses.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of contact suggestions to return.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: List contact notes
queries.description: List notes for one known contact, newest first. Get contactId from a contacts.contact ref; use returned contacts.note refs with note.read.

contactId.description: Contact ID returned by contact search, suggest, resolve, list, or a contacts.contact ref.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

queries.title: Read contact note
queries.description: Read one contacts.note ref returned by note.list after checking its parent contact and address book.

id.description: Contact-note ID returned by List contact notes or a contacts.note ref.

queries.title: List contact tags
queries.description: List tags in one known address book. Get bookId from book.list; use returned contacts.tag refs with tag.read or their IDs with contact.list and tag.change.

bookId.description: Address-book ID returned by List address books or a contacts.book ref.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Read contact tag
queries.description: Read one contacts.tag ref returned by tag.list after checking its owning address book.

id.description: Contact-tag ID returned by List contact tags or a contacts.tag ref.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

actions.title: Create contact
actions.description: Create one contact in an explicitly selected writable address book.

bookId.description: Public address-book ID that will own the contact.

parentContactId.description: Optional public parent contact ID in the same book.

tagIds.description: Complete replacement set of public book-scoped tag IDs.

emails.description: Complete replacement set of email addresses.

phones.description: Complete replacement set of phone numbers.

addresses.description: Complete replacement set of postal addresses.

bankAccounts.description: Complete replacement set of bank accounts.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

actions.title: Delete contact
actions.description: Permanently delete one contact after an optimistic version check.

contactId.description: Stable public contact ID to delete.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: updatedAt value returned by the last read; prevents stale deletion.

actions.title: Move contact
actions.description: Move a contact to another writable book. Book-scoped tags and hierarchy links are removed.

contactId.description: Stable public contact ID to move.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: updatedAt value returned by the last read; prevents stale moves.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

actions.title: Update contact
actions.description: Update selected contact fields; provided collection fields replace their current values.

contactId.description: Stable public contact ID to update.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: updatedAt value returned by the last read; prevents lost updates.

parentContactId.description: Optional public parent contact ID in the same book.

tagIds.description: Complete replacement set of public book-scoped tag IDs.

emails.description: Complete replacement set of email addresses.

phones.description: Complete replacement set of phone numbers.

addresses.description: Complete replacement set of postal addresses.

bankAccounts.description: Complete replacement set of bank accounts.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

actions.title: Set contact favorite
actions.description: Set or clear the current user's favorite state for one readable contact.

favorite.description: Desired favorite state for the current user.

actions.title: Create contact note
actions.description: Append a user-authored note to one writable contact exactly once.

contactId.description: Stable public contact ID that will own the note.

actions.title: Change contact tags
actions.description: Atomically add and remove book-scoped tags on one writable contact.

contactId.description: Stable public contact ID whose tags should change.

addTagIds.description: Public book-scoped tag IDs to add.

removeTagIds.description: Public book-scoped tag IDs to remove.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.
